items.quote: was buried near them in a cemetery that belonged to the kings, for people said, “He had leprosy.”
items.contrast: Uzziah’s leprosy as the reason for burial near his ancestors versus the royal cemetery as merely the burial location.
items.reason: The causal word “for” links his burial near, rather than with, his ancestors to people saying that he had leprosy. The cemetery’s ownership identifies the place but does not give the reason for the separation.
